paper_title: How Knowledge Popularity Influences and Enhances LLM Knowledge Boundary   Perception
caption: The QA performance, confidence, and alignment of Qwen2 under different question popularity.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: The line chart titled “Qwen2-7B on Movies” illustrates how three metrics — Accuracy, Confidence, and Alignment — change as a function of Question Popularity, ranging from 15 to 55. The horizontal axis, labeled “Question Popularity,” uses a linear scale with major tick marks at intervals of 5, starting at 15 and ending at 55. The vertical axis, labeled “Values,” also uses a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with major gridlines and tick labels at intervals of 0.2. Three distinct lines represent the metrics: Accuracy (blue line with circular markers), Confidence (green line with triangular markers), and Alignment (red line with square markers). All three lines show a generally increasing trend as Question Popularity increases. Accuracy starts at approximately 0.17 at popularity 15 and rises to about 0.87 at popularity 55. Confidence begins near 0.75 and increases gradually to approximately 0.95. Alignment starts around 0.42, rises with some small plateaus (e.g., between 18 and 20), and reaches approximately 0.93 at popularity 55. The Confidence line consistently remains above the other two across the entire range, while Accuracy starts lowest but shows the steepest overall increase, especially between popularity 20 and 30.
model_annotations.German: This line chart, titled “Qwen2-7B on Movies,” illustrates how three metrics—Accuracy, Confidence, and Alignment—change as a function of Question Popularity for the Qwen2-7B model. The x-axis, labeled “Question Popularity,” spans a linear scale from 15 to 55, with major tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled “Values,” ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 in increments of 0.2, representing normalized performance or score metrics. Three distinct lines are plotted: Accuracy (blue line with circular markers) begins at approximately 0.17 at Question Popularity 15 and rises steadily to about 0.86 at 55; Confidence (green line with triangular markers) starts at roughly 0.75 and increases gradually to 0.94; Alignment (red line with square markers) begins at approximately 0.42, shows a moderate rise with a slight plateau between 20 and 25, and reaches about 0.93 at 55. All three lines exhibit a generally increasing trend across the range of question popularity, with Confidence and Alignment starting higher and rising more gradually than Accuracy, which begins lower but increases more steeply, particularly after Question Popularity 25.
